findings.source: BioPharm International - "The New BioPharma Playbook: Seven Technologies Defining Drug Development in 2026"
findings.excerpt: The dominance of monoclonal antibodies and other therapeutic proteins is likely to continue in 2026 and beyond, however new modalities, such as cell and gene therapies, are getting traction and may eventually dethrone the more "classic" biologics. However, analysis of projected pipeline revenues reveals that established new modalities (mAbs, ADCs, BsAbs, recombinants, and CAR-T) continue to demonstrate robust growth, whereas some emerging modalities (gene, mRNA, and other cell therapies) have stalled.

findings.claim: 新創公司 Crescent Biopharma 正開發 PD-1xVEGF 雙特異性抗體 CR-001，其定位明確是要取代 pembrolizumab 作為免疫腫瘤療法的新骨幹用藥，相關臨床試驗於 2026 年啟動。
findings.source: DIMA Biotechnology - "2026 ASCO Target Review (Part II): Bispecific and Multispecific Antibodies and Immunotherapy Combinations"
findings.excerpt: Crescent Biopharma is developing CR-001, a PD-1 x VEGF bispecific antibody designed to bind both PD-1 and VEGF, which has potential to replace pembrolizumab (Keytruda) as the foundational immuno-oncology backbone. Clinical trials for CR-001, CR-002 and CR-003 were anticipated to initiate in 2026 along with the first ADC combination trial.

substitute_technology.note: 核心風險是 PD-1xVEGF 雙特異性抗體（ivonescimab、CR-001 等）與 pembrolizumab 生物相似藥（2028 專利懸崖）兩條線；Merck 已用 LaNova 併購與 Keytruda Qlex 劑型調整因應，但競品臨床頭對頭已有一次落敗紀錄。

findings.claim: Merck 與美國政府達成協議，計畫在美國推出「直接對病人銷售」(direct-to-patient) 通路，以平價提供關鍵產品給符合資格的病人，屬 2026年2月與川普政府藥價協議的一部分。
findings.source: Merck & Co., Inc. SEC Form 8-K, Exhibit 99.1
findings.excerpt: the Company plans to provide key products through a direct-to-patient program at affordable prices for eligible patients in the U.S.

findings.claim: 美國衛生部 (HHS) 於2026年1月27日發布新指引，釐清藥廠如何在不違反聯邦反回扣法的前提下，直接對病人（含 Medicare／Medicaid 參保人）提供低價處方藥，為產業性的直接對消費者(DTC)通路轉移提供法規基礎；聯邦政府另於2026年2月5日上線 TrumpRx.gov 作為導流入口，把病人導向藥廠自營 DTC 網站。
findings.source: HHS.gov press release; TrumpRx (Wikipedia); Galen Growth analysis

channel_business_model_shift.note: 查到 Merck 自身的直接對病人銷售計畫（官方 SEC 文件確認），以及 TrumpRx／HHS 引發的產業級通路轉移背景；未找到 Merck 傳統批發商／PBM 通路占比下降的具體數字，也未找到訂閱制或平台化的證據。
